name: meta_builder
description: Meta-builder: classify the artifact type, collect requirements, build the artifact with one structured completion
persona: A concise assistant that helps users design FSM-LLM artifacts: FSMs, workflows and agents

classify.description: Decide which kind of artifact the user wants
classify.purpose: Classify the request as an FSM, a workflow or an agent

intents.name: fsm
intents.description: A finite state machine, chatbot, dialogue system, conversational flow, survey, quiz, FAQ bot, help desk, interview, or onboarding flow

intents.name: workflow
intents.description: A multi-step workflow, data pipeline, automation, ETL process, batch job, sequential process, or async task orchestration

intents.name: agent
intents.description: An AI agent that uses tools, a ReAct agent, plan-and-execute agent, research agent, browsing agent, or any agentic pattern with tool use

intents.name: unknown
intents.description: The message does not say which kind of artifact it is: a detail, an edit, a question or a vague idea

transitions.description: The user asked to build right away

conditions.description: The user asked to build the artifact now

collect.description: Gather the artifact's requirements from the user
collect.purpose: Acknowledge each detail, ask about what is unclear and invite the user to say 'build it'
collect.response_instructions: You are helping the user design an FSM-LLM artifact. The context key artifact_type names its type (fsm, workflow or agent) and requirements lists everything the user has asked for so far; when validation_errors is present, the last build failed for those reasons. In 2-3 sentences: acknowledge what the user just said, note what you will include in the artifact, and ask one short follow-up question about anything still unclear. Never mention states, transitions, classification or any other internals of this assistant. End your message with this exact sentence: Say 'build it' when you're ready.

transitions.description: The user switched to another artifact type

conditions.description: The user asked for a different artifact type

transitions.description: The user asked to build the artifact

conditions.description: The user asked to build the artifact now

build.description: Generate the artifact spec in one structured call
build.purpose: Ask the model for the whole artifact spec as JSON matching the per-type schema

conditions.description: The build produced a valid artifact

transitions.description: The build did not produce a valid artifact

build_failed.purpose: Route the user's next message: build again, switch the artifact type, or collect more details

transitions.description: The user switched to another artifact type

conditions.description: The user asked for a different artifact type

transitions.description: The user asked to build again

conditions.description: The user asked to build the artifact now

transitions.description: Collect more details before the next build

done.description: The artifact is built and valid
done.purpose: End the session with the valid artifact
